book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

scope.purpose: Source-certify the 33 KOTOR weapon claims using the accepted Core gold weapon schema, with only source-proven schema extensions.

inherits.rule: KOTOR entries must conform to the Core gold contract unless KOTOR itself proves a required extension.

sourcePolicy.primary: SAGA EDITION - Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide.pdf
sourcePolicy.searchLayer: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide_djvu.txt
sourcePolicy.repoRole: comparison target only; never source authority
sourcePolicy.verificationRule: Every KOTOR weapon-table row was checked against rendered PDF pages 64, 68, 180, and 202. Description mechanics were cross-checked against searchable source text.

alternateAttackProfiles.reason: Massassi Lanvarok has two published attack modes in one identity: 3d4 ranged disc and 1d8 two-handed slashing melee.
alternateAttackProfiles.rule: Each profile carries its own branch, structured base damage, damage type, and range authority; runtime modifiers apply after the active profile is selected.

specialRateOfFire.reason: Sonic Disruptor prints Rate of Fire = Special and can fire only once every other round.
specialRateOfFire.rule: Never coerce Special into S or A merely to fit the old vocabulary.

checks: 33 claims exactly: 12 Table 5-1 melee + 17 Table 5-2 ranged + 2 Table 11-2 ranged + 2 Table 12-2 identities.
All Table 5-2 Accurate/Inaccurate/Area footnotes are encoded as source qualities rather than inferred tags.
All published damage dice, stun entries, ROF, size, cost, weight, damage type, and availability are structured.
Lightfoil inherits the Core lightsaber-group DR-bypass rule; no other KOTOR weapon is marked ignoresDR without source authority.
Sonic damage is normalized as energy with sonic qualifier while preserving sonic-specific Deflect behavior in operation data.
No Phase 2 certification mutates production packs, runtime automation, feats, talents, or actor data.

bookLocalGuardrails: This package is standalone KOTOR authority only. Do not fold or merge it into a rolling/master authority unless the user explicitly requests that later.
Do not mutate packs/weapons.db, runtime code, feats, talents, actors, or schema files from this package.
Do not create the 13 repo-missing KOTOR records from this package.
Do not replace source qualities with repo properties/traits when they disagree.
Do not collapse Massassi Lanvarok to a single attack profile.
Do not coerce Sonic Disruptor Rate of Fire Special to S or A.
Do not invent armor-bypass behavior for sonic weapons.
Do not convert descriptive flavor into numerical mechanics unless the published source provides the rule.
